# Vendored UFC 6 input icons patcher

Source: https://github.com/thyaguster/ufc6-xbox-icons (v1.1.0), MIT licensed.

The core, Xbox and keyboard profiles, keyboard artwork generator, mapping editor, tests, and runtime notices are retained. The overlay's controller/restart wrapper lives in `src/game_icons_helper.py`. It saves edited mappings beside the installed helper and imports nearby PORTHEON bindings when no edited map exists. All replacement bytes are generated from the user's game; no game assets or backups belong in this directory or a release.
